output.analysis: This is an RFQ email from Dana Whitlock at Tidewater Process Services requesting a price quote for pipe, fittings, and a valve for a boiler feed rework. There is a general default: 'All pipe to be SCH 80 A106B seamless unless noted,' which applies to all pipe lines except the explicitly noted '3 lengths 3" SCH 40'. For the fittings, they are specified to be '3000# forged steel, socket weld' for all lines in that section. Quantities and units are clear on every line except line f, which spells out 'four' for 1-1/2" couplings; this is interpreted as 4 EA. All line items have explicit quantities, units, and specifications. No attachments, hidden, or struck-out content. No need for human review.
